== Usage ==
A named-parameter wrapper over {{tl|Infobox}} for Game Update articles —
the second infobox wrapper built (after {{tl|Engineer infobox}}), plain
Shape A (no structured-data backing), since a handful of Game Update
pages don't yet need the JSON/Lua machinery. Empty fields hide
automatically, same {{tl|Infobox}} mechanism.

<pre>
{{Game update infobox
 |release_date = 2025-04-30
 |version = Update 3 (client version 4.1.2.0 per Frontier's own update-notes URL)
 |platform = PC, Xbox, PlayStation
 |major_features = [[Colonisation]] economy rework
 |preceded_by = [[Trailblazers|Trailblazers Update 2]]
 |followed_by = To be added
}}
</pre>

Link <code>major_features</code> to the mechanic pages this update
introduced or changed — this is what lets
<code>Special:WhatLinksHere</code> on the update page answer "what did
this update affect," with no per-update category needed. See
[[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Updating Game Statistics]].
